description: This file contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure and manage IOptionFormatter and related resolvers, facilitating dependency injection and configuration of options formatters within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: OptionConfigureExtensionMethods
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure option formatters and resolvers.

methods.name: ConfigureFormatter
methods.description: Configures an options formatter for specified TOptions and TOptionFormatter types, adding it as a singleton service.

methods.name: ConfigureFormatter<TOptions>
methods.description: Configures an options formatter for TOptions, using the default formatter if available.

methods.name: TryConfigureFormatter
methods.description: Attempts to configure an options formatter for TOptions and TOptionFormatter if none is already configured.

methods.name: ConfigureFormatterResolver
methods.description: Configures a formatter resolver for TOptions and TOptionFormatterResolver types.

methods.name: TryConfigureFormatterResolver
methods.description: Attempts to configure a formatter resolver for TOptions and TOptionFormatterResolver if none is already configured.

methods.name: ConfigureNamedOptionForLogging
methods.description: Configures a named option to be logged by resolving its formatter via the formatter resolver.
